spoken_summary: Across all ONGC work centres, 2,000 executives have completed eight or more continuous years at their current station. Mumbai Western Offshore (440 officers) and Delhi HQ (280 officers) account for the largest clusters of long-stay personnel. Production and Drilling disciplines comprise 40.3% of the population.
display_text: Pan-India query across hrfin_gold.ssot_workforce_employee identifies 2,000 active executives with >= 8.0 years continuous stay across 15 work centres [1]. Mumbai (440) and Delhi (280) form the largest concentrations; technical disciplines account for 40.3%.

visual.title: All-India: executives with 8+ years continuous stay

insights_v2.text: 2,000 executives across all ONGC assets have completed 8 or more years at their current posting.
Western Offshore (Mumbai, 440 executives) and Corporate HQ (Delhi, 280 executives) represent the largest clusters of overstay.
Production and Drilling disciplines represent 40.3% (806 officers) of the long-stay population, exceeding the 40% operational threshold.
